programs.source: alphabet = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/' ['Man', 'Hello, World!', '', 'bold', 'a+b=c?'].each do |text| encoded = '' text.bytes.each_slice(3) do |chunk| size = chunk.length chunk += [0] * (3 - size) value = (chunk[0] << 16) | (chunk[1] << 8) | chunk[2] symbols = [18, 12, 6, 0].map { |shift| alphabet[(value >> shift) & 63] }.join encoded += symbols[0, size + 1] + '=' * (3 - size) puts %("#{text}" -> "#{encoded}")
